title: M0 formalization without rewriting historical evidence
objective: Prepare an externally approved engineering-only M0 acceptance and versioned evidence workflow while preserving the certified research baseline.
rationale: Independent review found technically passing scoped controls, a required-receipt status defect, unmeasured historical holdout bars/bytes, and no formal M0 registration. This draft does not close those governance gaps by declaration.
scope_in: Require exact VERIFIED status for every required receipt before gate hashing; missing or ambiguous receipts block.
Adopt the safe successor entry point explicitly for new M0 evidence; assess the accessible historical surface.
Propose a separate versioned M0 engineering registry and a verifier bound to it, without mutating historical registries.
Preserve and evaluate all 14 inherited immutable invariants without weakening them.
Define a reviewed basis and scope for holdout read measurements; unknown historical reads remain UNKNOWN and block unsupported zero-read claims.
Prepare independent receipts and a formal M0 gate only after explicit approval and implementation of this draft.
scope_out: LIVE authorization, order placement, DEMO runner changes, strategy research, HYP-21, M1 progression.
Reading, hashing, or unlocking real FINAL_HOLDOUT or credentials.
Retrospectively inventing zero counters or changing historical receipt statuses.
Rewriting the original V2 design, research baseline, canonical registries, frozen candidates, or historical gates.
Treating a FASE 6.11 gate or a metadata-only PASS as an M0 approval.
files_forbidden: Existing historical reports and evidence snapshots
data_allowed: Governance metadata, permitted source code, exclusively synthetic fixtures
data_forbidden: Real FINAL_HOLDOUT, credentials, trading database contents

acceptance_criteria.description: Human approval of this exact draft scope is recorded before any formal M0 registry/verifier implementation; the existing V2 design is not silently rewritten.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Independent review of the approved specification and versioned approval receipt.

acceptance_criteria.description: All required receipts are uniquely indexed, exactly VERIFIED, SHA-256 bound, and evaluated using the checked metadata snapshot; missing, duplicate, or any other status blocks.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Run adversarial receipt-status tests and positive controls on the current pinned successor sources.

acceptance_criteria.description: All 14 inherited immutable invariants are preserved and individually supported by evidence of the claimed scope; UNKNOWN or PARTIAL is not accepted as PASS.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Independent invariant-by-invariant assessment, including read measurements and explicit residual-surface disposition.

acceptance_criteria.description: Historical files and records remain unchanged; the proposed M0 registry and verifier are separately versioned and cannot authorize research, LIVE, or M1.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Compare approved historical baseline hashes and test isolated registry/verifier binding.

acceptance_criteria.description: An auditor distinct from the implementer verifies the current evidence and a deterministic M0 gate satisfies every required receipt, criterion, and test without unresolved blockers.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Independent gate reconstruction and recorded external disposition; do not reuse FASE 6.11 as an M0 gate.

rollback_plan: If approved implementation fails, retain evidence of the failed revision and keep M0 BLOCKED. Do not delete historical snapshots, mutate sealed records, or weaken controls to obtain PASS.

risks.risk: Historical bars/bytes read measurements cannot be reconstructed from current metadata alone.
risks.mitigation: Do not backfill zeros. Define prospective measurements and require reviewed evidence for any historical claim; retain BLOCKED if the immutable criterion cannot be supported.

risks.risk: Direct historical calls remain accessible outside the successor CLI.
risks.mitigation: External reviewer must approve an explicit usage and residual-risk disposition without claiming a global sandbox or implicitly implementing M2.

risks.risk: A separate M0 registry could become an unverified parallel certification authority.
risks.mitigation: Approve and independently test the deterministic verifier and registry binding before registering any PASS gate.

notes: Prepared at the user's request on 2026-10-01. DRAFT only: no task, receipt, registry, verifier, or M0 gate is created or approved by this preparation. M1 requires separate explicit authorization after a valid M0 closure. Existing historical receipts are useful audit evidence and must be retained.
